Consider the shaded region $D$ shown above. What is the area of the image of $D$ under the action of the linear transformation $T$ with the standard matrix $T,$ given below?

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}2 & 5 \\ -1 & 3\end{aligned}].
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
Recall that for any linear transformation $T,$ we have the following connection between the area of $D$ and the area of the image $T(D)$ under the action of $T:$

$$
\text{Area}(T(D))=|det(T)|\cdot \text{Area}(D).
$$

From the diagram, we have

$$
\text{Area}(D)=\frac{1}{2}\cdot 2\cdot (2+4)=6.
$$

Computing the determinant of $T,$ we get 

$$
det(T)=2\cdot 3-5\cdot (-1)=11.
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Area}(T(D)) & =|det(T)|\cdot \text{Area}(D) \\  & =|\,11\,|\cdot 6 \\  & =66.\end{aligned}
$$
